notes.title: Roadmap and our plans!
notes.content:
[b] Hi there! [/b]
[i] Thank you for buying our game and supporting us with your pleasant reviews! You are the best! [/i]

Today we want to share our [i]roadmap[/i] with you that shows the main plans for the development of [b]"Destruction Time!"[/b] and what we want to see in it.

[url=https://trello.com/b/SZeaD54H/destruction-time-roadmap]Roadmap here.[/url]

First of all, we would like to note the new game modes that we will definitely add to our game.
[list]
[*][b]Sandbox[/b]. Yes, for now you can select any structure and smash it without targets. But we will transfer this opportunity to a new game mode "Sandbox", where you can destroy buildings with any available tool.
[*][b]Catapult[/b]. Catapult (О_О)?! Yes, catapult! We believe that destroying castles, fortresses and towers with the a catapult is a very fun! Therefore, we decided to add this feature to our game. Of course, with their own goals and objectives!
[*][b]From the first person[/b]. We have not yet decide how to call this mode, but you will take the role of a wall-breaker with a big hammer! Crush, break, watch how everything collapses around!
[*][b]Bowling[/b]. This is a special game mode where you have to throw rocks like a bowling balls from mountains and watch them rolls through small villages and destroy everything in their path! [/list]
And that is not all! We plan to add new buildings, improve game optimization and rework the graphics! Yes, you are not mistaken, we will rework the visual representation of our game!
What do we want? We want to create beautiful dioramas with buildings and constructions for destruction, and you can not only watch the beautiful destruction, but also enjoy the environment.

And a lot of small fixes and improvements that you will appreciate!

Also, don't forget to send your ideas via Discussions on Steam! We develop this game for you after all =)

Thank you! Have a nice day!
Dat Cat Studio Team.
